messages.subject: Project Marlin - cap table and funds flow for sign-off
messages.plaintextBody:
Gavin,

Attached the cap table (pre and post) and the funds flow for sign-off. Price per share £16.07; 1,119,847 new B shares for £18m. Westbridge 933,206 shares (£15m), Ravensworth 124,427 (£2m), angels 62,214 (£1m). Pool comes out at 12% post-money. Funds flow nets the £45k+VAT investor cost contribution and our fees, with the balance to the company account. Please confirm the company bank details are unchanged.

Elena

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
